## Standing operator rules
Never place raw email addresses, postal addresses, or payment tokens in `ledgerly/logs/`, including temporary debug statements.

Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.

Sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix the dunning email scheduler in `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`, which sends reminders to customers who already paid. The router split is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Webhook retry decorator with five attempts; it resent customer emails.

## Recent work
Fixed completed billing events accumulating: move `pending_events.pop()` only after successful event persistence, and copy incoming batches before extending pending events. All 27 worker/consumer tests pass. Diagnostics confirm completed events still cause linear memory growth, so investigation remains incomplete. Currency-rounding tests and lint pass; full suite passed. Redis backfill and 100,000-key reconciliation completed successfully.
